title: World of Mysteries Story Book control v1.0
description: Typed payload contracts for `story.storybook.get`, the PRD §20.1 reading-mode call. JSON Schema validates wire shape only. Session ownership and finalization are service-level concerns: the Engine answers `story_session_not_active` for an unknown session and for one whose Episode has not settled, and `storage_failure` when a committed chapter cannot be read. The response body is the Story Book itself with no envelope wrapper, so the DTO on both sides mirrors `storybook.schema.json` exactly.
